journey.bookedHint: Ehandiikirwe omwombeki - obugabe bw‘okukora bwaza aha mwombeki; attribution yaawe n’okuhikiirira kwa komishini nibibiikwa.
journey.notBookedHint: Okuhandiika nikuhamibwa omwombeki ku barikuheza kwikiriza okutwarwa.
journey.disputeBanner: Ondiijo munywani we ahakaniise obugabe bwa kasitoma ogu. Admin Leadrat ariyo naakishwijuma - oburinzi bwawe nibugumaho kuhisya obu baracwemu.
journey.cancelledHint: Omwombeki akashazamu okuhandiika - obugabe bw'okukora bwagaruka naiwe kandi n'okutunga akakiiko kusazibwamu. Nikigarurwaho abarikwebembera baaba baagarukire babuuka.

quick.notePlaceholder: Niki ekyabaho aha simu / okutaayaayira oku? (tikya boona)
quick.bookedLocked: Okwebembera oku kuhandiikirwe - embeera yaayo terikubaasa kugaruka kuhindurwa.
quick.viewOnly: Noobaasa kureeba obwebembezi obu, kwonka omurimo gwawe tigurikubaasa kubuhindura.

result.none: Tihariho ebyarugamu omu kwehandikisa eby'okworeka. Handikisa orikwebembera okubanza.
result.duplicateHint: Kasitoma ogu yaaheza kurindwa purojekiti egi ahabw’okwehandikisa okundi, n’ahabw’ekyo ekaba etarikubaasa kukuhandiikisa.

disputes.title: Entaana zangye
disputes.intro: Enkaayana z’obugabe ezi waareetaho ahabwa bakasitoma ezayangirwe nk’ezirikugarukagaruka. Omutegyeki Leadrat naashwijuma buri kimwe.
disputes.empty: Tihariho nshonga yoona ei waareetaho. Kasitoma ou wareetsire yaayanga nk'omuhandiiki, noobaasa kukihakanisa kuruga omu byarugamu omu kwehandikisa.
disputes.withdrawConfirm: Ihaho okuhakana kwawe ahabwa {{name}} ? Obukama oburiho hati nibuguma nk’oku buri.
disputes.raiseHint: Kasitoma ogu ku araabe yaabandize kwija ahariiwe, shoboorora ahabw’enki. Omutegyeki Leadrat naija kukireeba; ku barikucwamu omu rubaju rwawe, omwebembezi naahandiikwa ahabwawe.
disputes.notProtected: Tihariho orikugaruka kukwaata oburinzi ahari kasitoma ogu ahabwa purojekiti egi - noobaasa kuhandikisa omwebembezi hati.
